basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old university student majoring in Computer Science at UIUC. I have a deep interest in philosophy, especially Stoicism, which I discovered about a year ago. In my free time, I enjoy coding, reading about ancient philosophies, and following college sports, particularly the Tennessee Volunteers. I dislike unnecessary drama and prefer straightforward, meaningful discussions. I currently reside in Champaign, Illinois, and usually engage with Reddit during late evenings after study sessions. I'm single and find solace in both solitude and engaging with like-minded individuals online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science thanks to my coursework at UIUC. My interest in Stoicism was piqued by a philosophy class, which led me to self-study through books and online resources. I'm also familiar with JetBrains tools due to my coding projects.
